title: Healing French Tuna Terrine
description: A citrusy, creamy tuna terrine wrapped in flaky filo pastry, designed to soothe hangovers with a sattvic-friendly touch.
instructions: Zest the lemon and orange, then squeeze their juices into a bowl.
Season 300g of fresh tuna steak with the citrus zest, juice, salt, pepper, and chopped dill; let marinate for 15 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; add the finely diced shallot and sauté until translucent.
Add the marinated tuna to the skillet and sear for 2 minutes per side, then transfer to a plate and allow to rest for 5 minutes before flaking.
In a mixing bowl, combine the flaked tuna, 150g crème fraîche, 50g Greek yogurt, 40g melted butter, sautéed shallot, salt, and pepper; stir until a smooth creamy mixture forms.
Warm each of the 6 filo pastry sheets at 80°C for 1 minute, then lay one sheet on a clean surface and brush lightly with melted butter.
Spoon a generous amount of the tuna mixture onto the center of the filo sheet, roll tightly, and place the roll seam side down in a greased baking dish.
Repeat the previous step with the remaining filo sheets to form a layered terrine structure.
Bake the assembled terrine in a preheated 180°C oven for 15 minutes, or until the filo sheets are golden and crisp.
Let the terrine cool for 10 minutes, then slice into rounds and serve warm or at room temperature.
